name: team-nested-task-turn-other-run-rejected
description: Rule 43, for a nested lead: researcher-1's task turn belongs to the outer lead's run, and an operator's message through researcher-1's own team, a run of its own, is received inside it. The mail is the inner team's, the task envelope the outer team's; the task-turn clause is checked whatever team the mail belongs to: invalid_transition at the receipt, in the researcher's log.
